findings.title: Wrong mapping of trades/PnL/WR in T-1 diagnosis
findings.cause: Stats positions 0/1/2 displayed as trades/pnl/wr instead of net_wr/trades/final_capital.
findings.repair: Shared formatter uses positions 1/6/0/2 for trades/net PnL/net WR/capital.
findings.limits: Only diagnosis changed; no execution or fitness repair.

findings.title: Synthetic residual strictly negative
findings.cause: 31-bit numerator divided by 32-bit maximum before subtracting 0.5.
findings.impact: Scenario coverage can favor directional paths and fail to exercise others.
findings.acceptance: Versioned scenario family with distribution contracts and side-by-side historical comparison; do not silently replace fixture.

findings.title: Endpoint probes cannot prove global inertia or cover interactions
counterexamples: x*(1-x): zero at both endpoints, nonzero in interior
a*b: zero for either single-coordinate probe at baseline (0,0), nonzero jointly
findings.repair: Limit wording to observed absence of change under this probe and fixture.
findings.acceptance: Feasible interior/joint/context probes with documented design and limits.

findings.title: Requested vector perturbation may be erased or coupled
findings.prior_reference: D-656 derived anchors, not four new dead-gene discoveries
findings.repair: Log requested/realized coordinate and all changed slots.
findings.acceptance: Define effective degrees of freedom and admissible perturbations; do not equate 144 serialized coordinates to 144 independent genes.

findings.title: Eight-statistic sensitivity is not canonical fitness sensitivity
findings.cause: Any metric difference drives coverage; canonical promoter fitness not evaluated by comparison.
findings.acceptance: Typed metrics, validity, units, effective fitness version and selection trace; distinguish numerical tolerance and economic/statistical significance.

findings.title: Nonfinite comparison is not validity evidence
witness: NaN vs infinity treated as not different
finite vs NaN treated as sensitive
findings.compounding: Replay sanitizes nonfinite aggregates before this comparison.
findings.acceptance: Separate validity/failure channel with original stage and cause, before sanitization.

findings.title: Single synthetic BTC fixture does not certify multiasset continuous-spectrum evolution
findings.cause: One symbol/capital/tape/predictor lacks cross-asset competition, scale support and host-path coverage.
findings.acceptance: Causal context matrix, physical-time support, scale-specific uncertainty and net outcomes; no universal performance claim.

findings.title: Global model/environment/counter state limits diagnostic isolation
findings.cause: set_var and global model/reject counters share process state; test attribute does not force serial execution.
findings.acceptance: Explicit isolated context or separate processes, deltas and resource restoration.
findings.mitigation_this_run: Explicit --test-threads=1; fast contracts do not run core.

findings.title: Combined T-1 failure does not identify cause or authorize lowering ratchet
findings.reported_by: GLM in main76de9935; not Codex execution
findings.reported_result: PR20+CX below 11%, train_forest39/39; no per-gene count/list in note
findings.acceptance: Comparable Y00/Y10/Y01/Y11 cuts with precise commits, realized perturbations and per-gene/stat/stage differences; independent review before re-baseline.
